title: Threat from the left
description: A dark object dives at the fly from its left. The left eye's looming detectors fire, the giant fiber and the right-side steering neurons respond, and the fly turns right, away from it.

title: Threat from the right
description: The mirror image: the threat comes from the right and the fly turns left.

title: Baseline: no brain
description: The same body and gait with the brain switched off. The fly walks at a constant default drive; nothing reacts.
